name: 竹锋 · 劲竹战弓
design: A decisive strong huntress's BAMBOO WAR BOW: solid functional relatively robust curved laminated bamboo limbs, BAMBOO GREEN outer surface with pale golden inner wood strip. More STRAIGHT firm limb sections transitioning into angular but continuous recurved ends, distinct geometric profile rather than soft round bow; two or three broad bamboo-node bands across limbs, dark bronze plain reinforced tip caps and grip collars, wrapped dark brown sturdy short central handle. No sharp spikes, no gems or repeating diamond decorations. SINGLE straight taut bowstring joins tips. Arrow straight dark-bamboo shaft with a single short broad steel DIAMOND/leaf arrowhead, tightly shaped CHARCOAL and BAMBOO GREEN angular feather fletching, clear nock. Existing quiver becomes simple dark-brown leather with one angular bamboo-leaf stamp and matching three arrow feathers. Strong graphic nodes and angular blocks express confident strength; not merely recolor of existing generic bow.
